ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution (~92-95%) with localized high-intensity (white/cream) clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered across the central surface (~5-8%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous blobs located at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered small-scale white mottling and focal points distributed throughout the dark ventral field, with higher density on the lower-left and mid-right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is distinct though partially occluded by lower-frame water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Distinct jagged peaks are visible on the outer thirds of both lobes, interspersed with shallower valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer trailing margins of both lobes, exhibiting a symmetrical sweep toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the far left and far right distal tips. Isolated white circular spots visible on the interior of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear white streaks (rake marks) detected on the mid-to-outer portion of the left lobe, cutting through the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on distal tips creating irregular silhouettes; visible linear scarring across the central-left lobe area.
other_distinctive_markers: The far-left tip exhibits a bulbous, high-density barnacle cluster that creates a unique structural protrusion not mirrored identically on the right tip.
